attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Speech-Language Pathology / Board of Audiology (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved, sponsored or accepted by ASHA, the Michigan boards of audiology, medicine or osteopathic medicine, or any state SLP board (min 6, max 15 CPD hours); journal article reading (1 h each, max 5); approved presentations (2 h per 50-60 min, max 10); peer-reviewed exhibit/paper (2 h, max 10); authoring articles or textbook chapters (3 h each, max 9); clinical instruction and other activities listed in R 338.629
rules.new_licensee_rule: The 20 CPD hours apply to a licensee who was licensed for the full 2-year period before the license expiration date.
rules.audit_note: Submitting the renewal certifies compliance; keep documentation 4 years after applying for renewal. The department may audit and request proof.

topics.who: All licensees: pain and symptom management (MCL 333.16204), within the 20 hours
All licensees: 1 hour per year of the license cycle (R 338.7004); may count toward the 20 CPD hours
Applicants and licensees: one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.604); no hour minimum set

rules.notes: Michigan calls SLP continuing education 'continuing professional development' (CPD). No more than 12 CPD hours in one 24-hour period. No SLP assistant license in Michigan. ASHA-approved courses are accepted, but ASHA certification maintenance itself does not replace the state CPD hours.
rules.rule_quote: (2) An applicant for license renewal who was licensed for the 2-year period immediately preceding the expiration date of the license shall accumulate not less than 20 CPD hours in activities approved under R 338.629 during the 2 years preceding the end of the license cycle.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved under R 338.12 or by another state board of audiology (1 h per 50-60 min, max 20); presentations (3 h, max 9); publications and journal self-study with evaluation as listed in R 338.11
rules.new_licensee_rule: The 20 hours apply to a licensee who was licensed in the full 2-year period before the license expiration date.
rules.audit_note: Submitting the renewal certifies compliance; the department may audit and request proof.

topics.who: All licensees: pain and symptom management (MCL 333.16204), within the 20 hours
All licensees: 1 hour per year of the license cycle (R 338.7004); may count toward the 20 hours
Applicants and licensees: one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.1a); no hour minimum set

rules.notes: No more than 10 hours may be earned in one 24-hour period. Licensed by the Michigan Board of Audiology.
rules.rule_quote: (2) An applicant for license renewal who has been licensed in the 2-year period immediately before the expiration date of the license shall complete not less than 20 hours of continuing education in activities approved under these rules during the 2 years before the end of the license cycle.
